sloka: अप्रमत्तः बले कोशे दुर्गे जन पदे तथा ।भवेथा गुह राज्यम् हि दुरारक्षतमम् मतम् ॥२-५२-७२॥
transliteration: apramattaḥ bale kośe durge jana pade tathā ।bhavethā guha rājyam hi durārakṣatamam matam ॥2-52-72॥

translations.english: O Guha you must be vigilant about your army, treasury, forts and provinces. A kingdom, it is (rightly) said, is protected with great difficulty.
